description: Rebuilt 31-10-2026 from IVAO XG's 'Dubai SOP' Rev 1.0 section 3.2 'Runway Selection' (owner-supplied verbatim text, confirmed in an earlier session; direct re-fetch of the source 403'd this session, but a search-engine crawl of the same page independently corroborates the substance -- see docs/OMDB_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md). Ids use the project's usual runway-coded form. The SOP's wind thresholds (15 kt crosswind / 5 kt tailwind, in settings.json) are a real ICAO-MID regional benchmark (ATM SG/10-IP/4) that this source also applies to Dubai -- not confirmed as Dubai's own published figure; see the research doc for the full caveat. A dual-30-simultaneous-runway configuration mentioned by other secondary sources is not modelled: no switching criteria were found for it.

modes.description: SOP preferred config: main runway for departure is 30R, for arrival is 30L. Used normally unless the wind component (settings.json defaultCrosswindKt/tailwindDryKt) dictates otherwise.
SOP reciprocal config: 'otherwise normally Runway 12L use for Arrival and Runway 12R for Departure' -- the wind-driven fallback to the preferred pair, not a scheduled alternative.
